title: Peduli Satwa Action at BKSDA Kalbar: Supporting the Care of Wildlife and Forest Cats
excerpt: The Peduli Satwa (Care for Wildlife) action with BKSDA Kalbar supports the care of wild animals through feed, nutrition, and care equipment.
seoTitle: Caring for Wildlife at BKSDA Kalbar - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: The Peduli Satwa (Care for Wildlife) action with BKSDA Kalbar supports the care of wild animals through feed, nutrition, and care equipment.
html:
Caring for animals does not stop at rescue efforts; it also includes their care and meeting their daily needs. Through the Peduli Satwa (Care for Wildlife) action with the Balai Konservasi Sumber Daya Alam (BKSDA, the Natural Resources Conservation Agency) of Kalimantan Barat, Relawan Nusantara helped support the care of animals housed in the BKSDA Kalbar transit enclosures on Saturday, 3 October 2026.

The activity involved maintaining the enclosures, feeding the animals, and monitoring their condition together with the BKSDA Kalbar team. This support is expected to help meet the animals' needs while they are in care.

Caring for Wildlife Together with the BKSDA Kalbar Team

In this activity, volunteers helped clean the enclosures, feed the animals, and monitor the condition of the animals under BKSDA Kalbar's care.

The animals currently at the site include a Javan hawk-eagle (Elang Jawa), Kangkareng Perut Hitam and Kangkareng Putih hornbills, gibbons, tortoises, and a forest cat kitten.

The activity was accompanied by the BKSDA Kalbar team, namely drh. Ayu Komang Ria Trie Dewi Pinatih, M.Si., BKSDA veterinarian; Alexander Agustinus, BKSDA Polisi Kehutanan (forest ranger); and Hendra Yusimairi, BKSDA Kalbar staff member.

This guidance was an important part of ensuring that the care and feeding were carried out with attention to the animals' needs.

Support in Feed, Nutrition, and Animal Care Equipment

To support the care needs, Relawan Nusantara also delivered aid in the form of feed, nutrition, and personal protective equipment (PPE) for officers and volunteers.

The aid delivered included PPE, fruit and foodstuffs, and animal feed and nutrition.

The aid is expected to help meet the animals' feed and nutrition needs, while also supporting hygiene and safety during the care activities.

Collaboration to Safeguard Animal Welfare

The Peduli Satwa action also involved Damkar Kemuning (the Kemuning fire brigade) as a collaborating partner. Synergy among various parties is an important part of supporting animal care efforts, especially for wild animals that need special handling and attention.

Relawan Nusantara expresses its appreciation to BKSDA Kalimantan Barat, Damkar Kemuning, the donors, and all parties who have given their support to the continued care of the animals.

Caring for animals is part of the effort to maintain the balance of nature. Through simple steps taken together, the animals' needs can continue to be looked after and their welfare supported while they are in care.

Let's take a real part in safeguarding the conservation and welfare of wildlife in Kalimantan. We protect nature, and nature protects us.

Luaskan Manfaat
